knowledge_applicability.how_applied: Steps 3-6 supply the gate-power, decoupling, peak-current and resistor-pulse formulas; device selection is out of its scope.
Layout skill; only its hand-off (driver within 15 mm, Kelvin pours) is referenced, no calculation here.
DC-link procedure steps 1-4 with the buck pulsating input current instead of the DAB tank waveform; the 200 V output filter is sized by the buck ripple equation.
Bias-supply power budget per channel and 12 V input model (KR-IS-001); three UCC14141-Q1 modules (CR-12).
Sensing scaling, headroom (KR-SN-002) and the hardware OC path (KR-SN-005) are computed exactly as the skill prescribes.
Shared-sink budget with this design's 50 degC, 150 degC limit, 0.30 K/W sink and 1.4 K/W pad; TI's 40 degC / 0.5 / 0.1 K/W instance values are not used.
C >= dQ_max/dV with dQ = D(1-D) Io Ts derived for the buck (exact at all corners).
Film RMS current versus the 10 kHz / 70 degC / dT 20 K rating, self-heating via ESR x R_th; output capacitor by extension of the DC-link condition.
Two-tier bank; the HF tier is sized by the film-to-ceramic resonance model (TI's purpose is inferred, not stated).
No transformer, no DC-blocking capacitor.
Rails +15/-4 V +/-1.3 % plus < 0.5 V gate-loop overshoot checked against -10/+23 V (datasheet) - not the Gen-3 example limits.
Split R_G,on / R_G,off used in the peak-current and resistor-power formulas.
Charge-based (Q_gd) off-state excursion replaces the small-signal C_rss dv/dt R estimate; the Miller clamp is REQUIRED (not optional) pending the PRD-09301 6.1 measurement.
DESAT trip 3.6 V / blanking 288 ns derived from the C4MS025120K data (TIDA 6.4 V / 1 us not copied); values must be confirmed on hardware.
-4 V turn-off kept because the synchronous buck is a complementary half bridge (the buck exclusion of PRD-04814 does not apply).
+15/-4 V shared with the C3M0021120K fallback; +18 V is a C4MS-only BOM option (same-supplier generation change).
Dead time from the ePWM dead-band module; 150 ns minimum derived from skew/PWD/td; cross-wired IN+/IN- interlock.
Soft turn-off (400 mA) fault overshoot computed; module-scoped rule applied to a discrete.
Both forms shown: Wolfspeed Q_G f_sw dV (0.119 W) and the recorded TI factor-2 conflict (0.24 W); the budget uses the larger.
i_CM = (C_IO,bias + C_IO,driver) dv/dt for the HS barrier at 120 V/ns (3.5 pF and 5 pF bound).
No shared supply: dedicated sensing module (CR-12); the COM-VEE sourcing check (RLIM) is reported for review.
Regulated module, no LDO post-regulation; droop of the gate decoupling computed from Q_G.
Hard constraint: DESAT response 0.55-1.07 us against the <= 1.5 us budget; the withstand time is unpublished, so compliance is by destructive test (owner: gate-driver/test).
Latched OC path: TMCS1133 OC -> latch -> RST/EN + TZ1; UVLO non-latched run permit.
eFuse thresholds (10.0 / 14.45 V, I_CB 1.96 A) computed; review against downstream ratings is the rule's verification method.
Isolation ratings of UCC21710-Q1, UCC14141-Q1, AMC1311, TMCS1133 taken from datasheets; UCC14141 certificate status is an open item.
Ladder full scales 602 V / 302 V and the 0.33 V + 50 mV/A current scaling keep every measured value inside the 2 V isolator range and the 0-3 V ADC.
TMS320F28335 has no sigma-delta filter module.
Hall sensor, no shunt.
Hardware trip chain 546 ns computed; ADC loop shown too slow (output short ramps to trip in 4-7 us).
P_max = (T_J,lim - T_A)/(2 R_th,HS + R_pad + R_JC) = 41.5 W (margin 1.22 over the 34.1 W HS corner); T_J at every corner incl. the stacked worst case.
Pad resistance 1.4 K/W (exposed-tab area, CR-21) in the budget; pad voltage rating vs impulse basis stays a human-review conflict (CR-13).
NTC readout and NTC-to-T_J offset computed; 80/90/100 degC thresholds (CR-25) are proposals (cooling supervision, not junction protection).
IPC-2221 copper widths and via counts (rule is a low-confidence pattern; sizing method added).
Hard-switched buck; no soft-switching boundary.
Element voltages of the bleeder/indicator chains computed; spacing itself comes from the standards agent (not recomputed here).
DESAT trip and blanking formulas (EC-001/EC-002 pattern) with the C4MS025120K values 2.2 k / 4.99 k / 1.0 k / 680 pF.
Mezzanine link, no cable; RS-422 fallback only.

limitations: Switching-energy scaling (E ~ V, E ~ I, k_RG 1.3-2.0) carries about +/-30 % uncertainty plus the k_RG range; E_rr at the design di/dt is uncertain by about a factor of two; a double-pulse test at 400 V / 30 A is the verification step.
No circuit, thermal or electromagnetic simulation underlies any number here; everything is a first-order analytical estimate (verification level 'analytically-checked' at best).

Heat-sink data (0.30 K/W, airflow, fan current, mass, natural-convection resistance) are distributor-level; the Fischer LAM 5 D K 100 12 datasheet was not accessible; the pad resistance 1.4 K/W rests on the exposed-tab area read from the package table (CR-21) and is to be measured.
R_DS(on) at 150 degC is interpolated from the 25 / 175 degC datasheet points with the 18 V tempco; the 57.2 mohm maximum is scaled from the 18 V maximum (no 15 V maximum is published).

The body-diode voltage slope (0.07 ohm) and the E_oss voltage exponent (1.5) are added assumptions; the inductor hot-spot allowance (+10-15 K), surface area (161 cm2) and still-air correlation are empirical with roughly +/-30 % accuracy.
MLCC DC-bias (40 % remaining at 440 V), film-to-ceramic interconnect inductance (20-40 nH) and loop resistance (6-20 mohm) are assumptions until the layout is extracted and the TDK curve is read.
The 10 s overload is treated as thermal steady state (conservative for the sink and the choke).
The merged-bleeder discharge uses an ideal-diode two-bank model with 1 ms steps; LED forward drops are only included in the element-stress figures.
The precharge PTC parameters (R25, C_th, T_ref) belong to a part still to be re-selected (CR-19); results are shown for the candidate ranges.
open_items: Parasitic turn-on: the charge-based RC model spans 3.6-7.0 V of off-state excursion over the stated Q_gd (20-27 nC) and edge (8-13 ns) ranges, i.e. V_GS up to about +3 V against the 2.0 V (25 degC) minimum threshold; the baseline's 4.5-5.2 V is the mid-range. Miller clamp mandatory; off-state V_GS measurement (PRD-09301 6.1) decides R_G,off and bias.

NTC-to-T_J offset with the 1.4 K/W design pad is 58 K (typical, 440 V / 27.5 A) to 69 K (max-R, 360 V / 27.5 A) at full load, consistent with the baseline's 50-66 K band; the 100 degC hardware comparator trip (CR-25) then maps to T_J about 158-169 degC and the 90 degC firmware trip to about 148-159 degC at full load - the hardware trip stays below the 175 degC absolute maximum, both levels exceed the 150 degC design limit toward the max-R overload corner, which the 80 degC derate / overload inhibit addresses; the earlier 90/100/110 degC ladder (hardware trip at T_J about 168-179 degC) was lowered by CR-25 and a firmware T_J estimator is recommended (KR-TH-003).

Fan-fail time from the 68 degC steady state is 117-263 s to the 90 degC firmware trip and 179-416 s to the 100 degC hardware trip (CR-25) for the lumped D K sink (R_nat 1.73-2.5 K/W and mass 0.3-0.6 kg unverified), not the 50-100 s to 100 degC carried in the baseline (that figure was the single-width unit from 88 degC); the conclusion (T_J > 175 degC at stall, OTP and FAN_TACH derate mandatory) stands.

Merged bleeder + indicator networks discharge both banks in about 20 s (bleeders alone about 36 s); the baseline's 'about 30 s' is the nominal-C bleeder-only estimate. Output indicator chain (2 x 100 k 1206) sees 220 V / 0.48 W per element under a high-side-short fault at 440 V - above typical 1206 ratings; use >= 3 elements or 2512 parts if the fault must be survived.

Aux 12 V: the pull-in total (1.76 A at 10.8 V) exceeds an assumed -10 % circuit-breaker minimum (1.76 A) with zero margin for the 50 ms relay operate time; stagger fan start and relay pull-in or move the fan upstream of the eFuse (baseline fallback).
Mezzanine 12 V pins carry 0.43-0.49 A each (fan, relay coil and bias modules all sit on the power board), above the architecture's 0.4 A per-pin target but 6x below the 3 A WR-PHD rating.

Dead-time loss with V_SD at the actual current is 3.1-3.6 W (250 ns) / 3.8-4.3 W (300 ns) versus the 2.9-3.2 W flat-4.6 V figures of the baseline loss table (body-diode slope 0.07 ohm is an unverified assumption).

V2.2 E22-02: TI SLUSF10B Eq.9 dual-positive RLIM limit is 5 V / 20.4 mA - 30 ohm = 215 ohm (typical internal resistance). Fitted 160 ohm, 0.66 W 1206 replaces 1 k placeholder; conservative resistor + internal FET steady loss about 0.204 W. Startup, stability, continuous-load regulator qualification and temperature remain open.

Bounded-worst efficiency is 98.27 % converter-only, 98.12 % with the aux electronics (baseline convention) and 97.96 % as a full system with relay hold and fan - at or just below the 98.0 % target and 0.5 % above the 97.5 % floor; the k_RG factor (1.3-2.0) is the largest single uncertainty and must be measured by double-pulse test.

The twentieth verification report (assumptions-register fact-check, verify_assumptions_register_and_requirements_se_factcheck.json) was recovered after the first run of this script; its required changes concern the register text (ADC LSB, inrush charge-time range, CTI class bound, the 0.51 A maximum rating of a candidate fan that is not the baseline part) and change no input of this script.
